meta.name: signup
meta.description: When the user wants to optimize signup, registration, account creation, or trial activation flows. Also use when the user mentions "signup conversions," "registration friction," "signup form optimization," "free trial signup," "reduce signup dropoff," "account creation flow," "people aren't signing up," "signup abandonment," "trial conversion rate," "nobody completes registration," "too many steps to sign up," or "simplify our signup." Use this whenever the user has a signup or registration flow that isn't performing. For post-signup onboarding, see onboarding. For lead capture forms (not account creation), see cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 简化注册流程，让更多访客完成注册
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果注册流程流失严重，想提升试用激活率
copy.tagline_en: Simplify signup to boost trial activation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your signup flow has high dropoff and you need more users to complete registration.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像注册流程优化专家：检查注册/创建账号/试用激活的步骤、字段和提示，找出用户放弃的点，给出减少填写负担、提高完成率的具体改法，并输出问题清单与按优先级排列的改动建议。
howto.when: 当你说到「注册转化」「注册摩擦」「没人完成注册」等词，或想优化注册、账号创建、试用流程时触发。

say.text: 我的注册页要填的字段太多，怎么精简？
say.note: 它会逐字段分析哪些能推迟或去掉。

say.text: 用户总在填写公司名称时放弃，怎么办？
say.note: 它会定位该字段的取舍并给出改法。

say.text: 免费试用注册完成率很低，帮我诊断。
say.note: 它会评估流程并列出高优先级修复。
